name: LIDAR

resources.name: LSLIDAR

resources.name: Innoviz

resources.name: Quanenergy

resources.name: Cepton
resources.desc: Cepton (Cepton Technologies, Inc.) / pioneers in frictionless, and mirrorless design, self-developed MMT (micro motion technology) lidar technology. The headquarter is located in San Jose, California, USA.

resources.name: Blickfeld
resources.desc: Blickfeld is a solid-state LIDAR manufacturer for autonomous mobility and IoT, based in München, Germany.

resources.name: Neuvition
resources.desc: Neuvition is a solid-state LIDAR manufacturer based in Wujiang, China.

resources.name: Aeva
resources.desc: Aeva is bringing the next wave of perception technology to all devices for automated driving, consumer electronics, health, industrial robotics and security, Mountain View, California, USA.

resources.name: XenomatiX
resources.desc: XenomatiX offers true solid-state lidar sensors based on a multi-beam lasers concept. XenomatiX is headquartered in Leuven, Belgium.

resources.name: MicroVision
resources.desc: A pioneer in MEMS-based laser beam scanning technology, the main focus is on building Automotive grade Lidar sensors, located in Hamburg, Germany.

resources.name: PreAct
resources.desc: PreAct's mission is to make life safer and more efficient for the automotive industry and beyond. The headquarter is located in Portland, Oregon, USA.

resources.name: Pepperl+Fuchs
resources.desc: Is a global technology company, specialized in innovative automation solutions and sensor technologies, such as LiDAR, based in Mannheim, Germany.

resources.name: Riegl
resources.desc: Riegl is a manufacturer of 3D laser scanning systems, based in Austria.

resources.name: ERDI
resources.desc: Laser rangefinder module and single-point LIDAR manufacturer (905 / 940 / 1535 nm, 9 m to 23 km), headquartered in Chengdu, China. Publishes an open specification dataset where every range figure keeps the verbatim test condition it was measured under.

resources.name: Ford Dataset
resources.desc: The dataset is time-stamped and contains raw data from all the sensors, calibration values, pose trajectory, ground truth pose, and 3D maps. The data is Robot Operating System (ROS) compatible.

resources.name: Audi A2D2 Dataset
resources.desc: The dataset features 2D semantic segmentation, 3D point clouds, 3D bounding boxes, and vehicle bus data.

resources.name: Waymo Open Dataset
resources.desc: The dataset contains independently-generated labels for lidar and camera data, not simply projections.

resources.name: Oxford RobotCar
resources.desc: The Oxford RobotCar Dataset contains over 100 repetitions of a consistent route through Oxford, UK, captured over a period of over a year.

resources.name: EU Long-term Dataset
resources.desc: This dataset was collected with our robocar (in human driving mode of course), equipped up to eleven heterogeneous sensors, in the downtown (for long-term data) and a suburb (for roundabout data) of Montbéliard in France. The vehicle speed was limited to 50 km/h following the French traffic rules.

resources.name: NuScenes
resources.desc: Public large-scale dataset for autonomous driving.

resources.name: Lyft
resources.desc: Public dataset collected by a fleet of Ford Fusion vehicles equipped with LIDAR and camera.

resources.name: KITTI
resources.desc: Widespread public dataset, pirmarily focusing on computer vision applications, but also contains LIDAR point cloud. ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/ROS-2-34aec5?style=flat-square&logo=ros)

resources.name: Semantic KITTI
resources.desc: Dataset for semantic and panoptic scene segmentation.

resources.name: CADC - Canadian Adverse Driving Conditions Dataset
resources.desc: Public large-scale dataset for autonomous driving in adverse weather conditions (snowy weather).

resources.name: UofTPed50 Dataset
resources.desc: University of Toronto, aUToronto's self-driving car dataset, which contains GPS/IMU, 3D LIDAR, and Monocular camera data. It can be used for 3D pedestrian detection.

resources.name: PandaSet Open Dataset
resources.desc: Public large-scale dataset for autonomous driving provided by Hesai & Scale. It enables researchers to study challenging urban driving situations using the full sensor suit of a real self-driving-car.

resources.name: USyd Dataset- The Univerisity of Sydney Campus- Dataset
resources.desc: Long-term, large-scale dataset collected over the period of 1.5 years on a weekly basis over the University of Sydney campus and surrounds. It includes multiple sensor modalities and covers various environmental conditions. ROS compatible

resources.name: Boreas Dataset
resources.desc: The Boreas dataset was collected by driving a repeated route over the course of 1 year resulting in stark seasonal variations. In total, Boreas contains over 350km of driving data including several sequences with adverse weather conditions such as rain and heavy snow. The Boreas data-taking platform features a unique high-quality sensor suite with a 128-channel Velodyne Alpha Prime lidar, a 360-degree Navtech radar, and accurate ground truth poses obtained from an Applanix POSLV GPS/IMU.

resources.name: Point Cloud Library (PCL)
resources.desc: Popular highly parallel programming library, with numerous industrial and research use-cases.

resources.name: Open3D library
resources.desc: Open3D library contanins 3D data processing and visualization algorithms. It is open-source and supports both C++ and Python.

resources.name: PyTorch3d
resources.desc: PyTorch3d is a library for deep learning with 3D data written and maintained by the Facebook AI Research Computer Vision Team.

resources.name: Kaolin
resources.desc: Kaolin is a PyTorch Library for Accelerating 3D Deep Learning Research written by NVIDIA Technologies for game and application developers.

resources.name: PyVista
resources.desc: 3D plotting and mesh analysis through a streamlined interface for the Visualization Toolkit.

resources.name: pyntcloud
resources.desc: Pyntcloud is a Python 3 library for working with 3D point clouds leveraging the power of the Python scientific stack.

resources.name: pointcloudset
resources.desc: Python library for efficient analysis of large datasets of point clouds recorded over time.

resources.name: LAStools
resources.desc: C++ library and command-line tools for pointcloud processing and data compressing.

resources.name: lasrs-cpp
resources.desc: C++20 and C library for reading and writing LAS, LAZ and COPC with parallel LAZ decoding, built on the Rust crates las-rs and laz-rs.

resources.name: Autoware
resources.desc: Popular framework in academic and research applications of autonomous vehicles.

resources.name: Baidu Apollo
resources.desc: Apollo is a popular framework which accelerates the development, testing, and deployment of Autonomous Vehicles.

resources.name: Study of LIDAR Semantic Segmentation
resources.desc: Scan-based Semantic Segmentation of LiDAR Point Clouds: An Experimental Study IV 2020.

resources.desc: General, Single-shot, Target-less, and Automatic LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration Toolbox

resources.desc: OGRE-based general-purpose robotic simulator, ROS/ROS 2 compatible.

resources.name: CARLA

resources.name: LGSVL / SVL
resources.desc: Unity Engine based simulator for automotive applications. Compatible with Autoware, Baidu Apollo and ROS/ROS 2. *Note:* LG has made the difficult decision to suspend active development of SVL Simulator.

resources.name: OSSDC SIM
resources.desc: Unity Engine based simulator for automotive applications, based on the suspended LGSVL simulator, but an active development. Compatible with Autoware, Baidu Apollo and ROS/ROS 2.

resources.name: AirSim
resources.desc: Unreal Engine based simulator for drones and automotive. Compatible with ROS.

resources.name: AWSIM
resources.desc: Unity Engine based simulator for automotive applications. Compatible with Autoware and ROS 2.

resources.name: ARHeadsetKit
resources.desc: Using $5 Google Cardboard to replicate Microsoft Hololens. Hosts the source code for research on scene color reconstruction.

resources.name: CloudCompare

resources.name: Lichtblick suite

resources.name: Rerun

resources.name: MeshLab
resources.desc: MeshLab is an open source, portable, and extensible system for the processing and editing 3D triangular meshes and pointcloud.
